_readme: One entry per booking. slot ∈ spotlight | countdown | dhak | map-partner | pandal-nearby. Dates are IST calendar days (inclusive). For pandal-nearby, list pandalIds the shop is near. link may be a URL or empty; whatsapp is digits with country code (no +). logo is a path under /public (e.g. /sponsors/tota.png) or empty for text-only.
